people.line: Abantu obathumelela imisebenzi nalokho okwenziwe umsizi {name}, nabo abasebenzisa umsizi {name}, futhi obuthola kubo izimpendulo zabo. Yibo kuphela abangavula lokho obathumelela kona.
people.none: Akekho okwamanje. Engeza umuntu oseduze nawe ngekhodi ayiskena, noma umuntu okwenye indawo ngesixhumanisi.
people.nobody: Akekho onaleli gama enhlanganweni yakho osebenzisa umsizi {name} okwamanje.
people.mailBody: Ngisebenzisa umsizi {name} emsebenzini, futhi singathumelelana imisebenzi ngawo. Vula lesi sixhumanisi bese ungena nge-akhawunti yakho yasemsebenzini: {link}
people.joined: Umuntu {name} manje usebenzisa umsizi {app}. Ningathumelelana imisebenzi.
people.ways: Ikhodi uma eseduze nawe, isixhumanisi uma esekwenye indawo.
people.qr: Isimemo njengekhodi ye-QR, sekhamera yefoni yakhe
people.point: Ukhombisa ikhamera yefoni yakhe ekhodini, noma avule isixhumanisi. Kusebenza ngenkathi lokhu kuhlala kuvuliwe.
people.week: Kuthumele ngendlela omthumelela ngayo noma yini enye. Kusebenza isonto.
people.typeCode: Izinombolo eziyisithupha umuntu {name} akubonisa zona noma azibuyisela
people.added: Umuntu {name} usebantwini bakho. Uma esephendule, ningathumelelana imisebenzi.
people.accepted: Othile wamukele isimemo sakho somuntu {name}. Bhala izinombolo eziyisithupha akuthumelele zona.
people.again: Kufanele nihlangane futhi: ukhiye wakhe ushintshe ngendlela engakwazanga ukuhlolwa
people.remove: Khipha umuntu {name}? Lokho akuthumelele kona kuhlala kungokwakho.
people.invited: Othile uyakumema ukuthi nithumelelane imisebenzi ngomsizi {name}.
people.showCode: Bonisa lezi zinombolo kumuntu oseduze nawe, noma uzibuyisele ngendlela isimemo esifike ngayo
people.metThem: Umuntu {name} manje usebantwini bakho. Ningathumelelana imisebenzi.
people.why.large: Lokhu kukhulu kakhulu ukuthi kuthunyelwe. Ngaphandle kwalokho umsizi {name} akufundile, noma ingxenye yakho, kungase kungene.
people.why.unreached: Lokhu akufikanga kubo. Hlola uxhumano bese uzama futhi.
people.why.link: Lesi akusona isixhumanisi sesimemo. Sicele futhi.
people.why.gone: Lesi simemo simisiwe noma siphelelwe yisikhathi. Cela esisha.
people.why.self: Lesi yisimemo sakho. Sithumele komunye umuntu.
people.why.tries: Imizamo emithathu engalungile: kumile, ukuze kuphephe. Qala futhi.
people.why.relay: Lokhu akufinyeleleki okwamanje. Hlola uxhumano bese uzama futhi.
people.why.refused: Inhlangano yakho ayikuvumeli ukufinyelela lo muntu.
people.why.inside: Inhlangano yakho yengeza abantu abasohlwini lwayo. Bathole ngegama esikhundleni salokho.
people.invites: Umuntu {name} ukumema ukuthi nisebenze ndawonye kulokhu: “{title}”
people.nudge: Kukhona okufikele wena. Vula umsizi {name} ukuze ukubone.
